Description
1 oz Pamp Suisse American Buffalo Gold Bar is manufactured by the bullion brand –
PAMP Suisse
which is recognized around the globe for its innovative designs, state-of-the-art facilities, and industry-leading efforts to curtail
precious metal counterfeiting
.
PAMP Suisse, a prominent Swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting,
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold bar contains 1 troy oz of gold of purity .9999 and comes with its original tamper-evident assay card which authenticates the weight and purity of the gold. The weight and purity of these gold bars are backed by the PAMP Suisse.
The assaying services of the bullion brand PAMP Sussie are world-famous likewise, it is among the world’s premier private mints which are manufacturing such amazing gold bars and ingots. This is why the gold investors and collectors have trust in precious metal items such as
gold
and silver from PAMP Suisse.
Design of 1 oz PAMP Suisse American Buffalo Gold Bar (in Assay)
The obverse side features PAMP Suisse logo. Inscriptions: 1 oz and FINE GOLD 999.9, and unique serial number The reverse side features the American Buffalo, a symbol of the American West and Native American heritage.
Main Highlights of 1 oz PAMP Suisse American Buffalo Gold Bar (in Assay)
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Weight and Purity backed by the PAMP Suisse.
Mint uses a thin, plastic sheeting to protect your assay card when it is shipped.
Eligible to Precious Metal IRAs.
Features its own unique serial number
